        "Full one-file owned diff read. Both hooks add the cookie immediately after the duplicate guard, then create the deferred release and timer. Previously the certificate hook awaited localization before adding the cookie. The owned change also resolves the ordinary hook deferred on test-suppressed and silent returns. No tests changed.",

Neither key includes message text, so the identical-alert comment means matching cookie rather than matching every displayed message. The historic nsIObserver alertfinished path and current nsIAlertCallbacks finish path remain distinct source phases.",
        "Resolving the deferred schedules Set deletion through its promise callback. The timer requests release after five seconds; event-loop scheduling is not a wall-clock guarantee. A notification or localization operation can outlive this suppression window. Ordinary backend failure returns false without resolving early; MailSession can then show a modal prompt. Certificate errors have a void interface and the C++ dispatcher does not await the async hook.",
        "The existing certificate-context lesson is reused: releasing the cookie does not erase the securityInfo/uri captured by the dialog callback. This change concerns suppression reservation order, not callback ownership, certificate validation policy or a guarantee that all duplicate alerts disappear.",
